g.text: Synthetic 30 m imagery (2.4 km × 2.4 km): puffy Gaussian plumes, 300–5 000 kg/h, winds 1.5–8 m/s, 50 ppb pixel noise plus correlated surface artefacts. Mask:
smoothed image above 2σ, connected to the source. U_eff fitted on 300 plumes, tested on 146. Q = U_eff · IME / L, L = √(mask area).
